question: What is the average lap time in milliseconds of all the lap records set on the various circuits in Italy?
clarification: Count each distinct lap only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.milliseconds) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.lap) FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.milliseconds) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.lap) FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy'

d.request: What is the average lap time in milliseconds of all the lap records set on the various circuits in Italy, counting each distinct lap only once (i.e., averaging over distinct lap times rather than duplicate entries)?
d.sql: SELECT AVG(DISTINCT lt.milliseconds) FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy'

b.request: Compute the average of lap times in milliseconds across distinct laps (each distinct lap counted once, with duplicate lap records removed) recorded at races held on circuits located in Italy
b.sql: SELECT AVG(milliseconds) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, lt.lap, lt.milliseconds FROM lapTimes lt JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Italy')
